title: Art Talk Tape: Work and the Freelance Lifestyle
content: In the 1980s I was part of a group of friends called "The Golden Palm Tape Network" who shared conversations about art via cassette tapes that we would mail to each other. Here's a sample of a vintage "podcast" on the topic of work and the freelancer. (Link to podcast on YouTube)Contributors include fellow fantasy- and comic artistsJames Warhola(Uncle Andy's),Paul Chadwick(Concrete) (at 29:45), andTom Kidd(Gnemo).---Previous podcast:"Academic Chatter: Gerome, Repin, and Shishkin"More about theGP Tape NetworkSong "Caterpillar Man" is byCarl Trent
